claims.claim: Brought news from Augusta, Ga, to 1866-06-09
claims.citation: New York Herald, 13 June 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
BARK GEO H JENKINS—Augusta, Ga, June 9—The Br bark
George H Jenkins, with 420,000[?] feet lumber, from Fernan-
dina for Queenstown, is lodged on St Mary's Bar. The
United States steamer Conemaugh made two unsuccessful
attempts to get her off. It is thought, however, that vessel
and cargo may be saved.
